description: Instantly redesign and upgrade any existing WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, GoDaddy, or PHP website into a modern, blazing-fast Next.js App Router website. Scrapes the existing URL's branding, services, and copy and returns a live interactive Next.js preview link.

abVariant.description: Pricing variant: 'A' ($0 Free Setup + $29/mo), 'B' ($49 Setup + $19/mo), or 'C' ($29/mo Flat).

url.description: The existing website URL to scrape and redesign into Next.js (e.g., 'https://example.com').
